description: Alternative Fourth-Way root composition with exactly the premises of CATHOLICISM-FROM-QUARTA-VIA-WITH-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES except STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING. The maximum comes from QuartaViaMaximumInBeing.maximeEnsCausesBeingOfAll, which adds no premise to the route but applies the grades-to-maximum principle at esse as well as at truth and actuality only insofar as being at truth. The truth bridge is omitted, not refuted or proved. The historical end remains a structural transcription conditional on revelation, history and authority bridges. All listed premises remain open, and the selected First-Way root route is unchanged.
